subject: Willowbank Cottage — a large two-volume country cottage with a fenced kitchen-garden field of growing vegetables at the back
style: Warm English country cottage at minifigure scale; the design is original, studied against the building-atlas cottage/farmstead techniques without copying their massing
silhouette: A tall two-storey 20x14 hall with a steep dark-green gable, front dormer and rear chimney, joined to a low one-storey 10x10 kitchen wing with its own gable; a flat vegetable field behind the house, a layered-leaf tree framing the front-left, a second tree at the field's far right
site: 48x48 green baseplate (4186); front = -Z, X width, Z depth

dimensions.hall: 20 x 14 studs, 12 brick courses (walls ~304 LDU), roof gable 22 x 14 with 6 slope tiers, front dormer
dimensions.wing: 10 x 10 studs, 6 courses, gable 12 x 10, back door to the field
dimensions.field: 28 x 10 studs of soil beds behind the house, 5 beds x 4 studs, 2-stud grass aisles, fence perimeter with 3-stud gate
dimensions.total_height: ~464 LDU at the hall ridge, ~272 LDU at the wing ridge

palettes.crops: Orange (25) pumpkins/carrots, Yellow (14) and Red (4) flowers, Bright_Green (10) + Dark_Green (288) leaves, Dark_Pink (5) accents
palettes.path: Tan (19) tiles on the green plate

primary_focus: The porch and glazed door with flanking white-trimmed windows beneath the tall gable
supporting_features: The fenced vegetable field: five distinct crop beds (pumpkins, carrots, leafy greens, flowers, mixed), a two-tier lattice trellis with a draping vine, and a gate on the path
The chimney and dormer roofline that gives the hall its vertical mass against the low wing
detail_vocabulary: White window trim on every glazed bay, one shuttered window bay for character
Reddish-brown deck under the walls (visible as the ground floor string course)
Layered 45-degree slope courses with a tiled ridge
Garden fence with a matching gate, stepping-stone paths
Layered-leaf trees, a garden bench, and flower boxes flanking the steps
quiet_surfaces: The upper fields of wall between windows
The grass margins around the soil beds
modules: willowbank-scene.ldr (main): baseplate, module placement, paths, landscaping
hall-shell.ldr: 20x14 two-storey shell, per-row windows, door at X=+2
wing-shell.ldr / wing-roof.ldr: 10x10 shell, back door to field, gable 12x10
porch-15-288-8-4-144.ldr, stairs-4-1.ldr, chimney.ldr: entry and ridge details
garden-field.ldr: soil beds, crop clusters, trellis + vine, fence + gate, field trees

crop_parts.pumpkin: 51270 (Plant Pumpkin, origin near top, bottom local +32)
crop_parts.root_vegetable: 37681 (Plant Root Vegetable with Stud and Bar)
crop_parts.trellis_vine: 16981 (16L horizontal vine) on two 3633 lattice tiers; 73828 thorn vine as lower accent

constraints: Reserve all door/window openings before walling (per-row window lists, no overlaps)
All ground-level content follows the atlas convention: baseplate at y=0, tiles/plates at h=8, raised beds one plate higher
Fence must not cross circulation routes; path passes through the gate
Chimney sits on the ridge tiles at the measured ridge height
Roof/dormer/chimney interfaces get dedicated section renders
review: Open home/front/back/right/top renders after the first build; verify silhouette readability at thumbnail, crop-bed legibility, path/gate continuity, chimney-dormer spacing, and palette balance; record findings in visual-review.md.
